editorial: Today, new architectures that increase the inference efficiency of artificial intelligence models and open-source visual generation tools are coming to the fore. Free computer science courses shared by Carnegie Mellon University stand out as the most remarkable development of the day in terms of access to educational resources.

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
items.summary: AG-UI is an open-source and lightweight communication protocol developed to integrate artificial intelligence agents into user interfaces. Thanks to its event-based structure, it aims to standardize the interaction between agents and application interfaces.

snapshot.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications. AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.

items.title: backnotprop/plannotator
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, plannotator combines planning, code review, and feedback processes for artificial intelligence agents into a single workspace. It allows users to organize their workflows with agents and share them within the team.

snapshot.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

items.title: dream-num/univer
items.summary: Univer is an open-source office software development kit (SDK) that allows developers to add editing, calculation, and collaboration features to their own products. This tool enables the creation of a customizable office environment for both humans and artificial intelligence agents.

snapshot.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.

items.title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
items.summary: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills is a Claude Code skills package that offers market analysis, technical charts, and strategy development tools for stock investors and traders. Prepared in Python, this project aims to automate financial workflows such as economic calendars and screeners with artificial intelligence.

snapshot.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code skills package developed for bug hunting and external red-team operations. Written in Python, this tool offers 82 skills covering 24 different vulnerability classes, 15 slash commands, and hundreds of report patterns.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: getarcaneapp/arcane
items.summary: Developed in the Go language, Arcane offers a modern interface designed to manage Docker containers. Aiming to appeal to users of all levels, this tool targets simplifying Docker management processes.

snapshot.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone. For setup instructions, configuration details, and development guides, visit the official documentation site.

items.title: DeanChensj/jiangshan-map
items.summary: DeanChensj/jiangshan-map is an interactive historical atlas and timeline application that examines Chinese history through 18 dynasties. Developed with JavaScript, this project presents the development of settlements from the ancient period to the present day and classical poetry routes on a map with 198 different regional images.

snapshot.description: 江山时序 · 中国历史交互地图时间轴 (403 BCE – Present) | Interactive Historical Atlas of China across 18 dynasties, 198 territory snapshots, ancient-to-modern place genealogy & classical poetry routes

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: stitch-skills, shared by Google, is an agent skills library designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library follows open standards to ensure compatibility with software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editing tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill offers an artificial intelligence skill that creates summaries on current topics by conducting research across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web. Developed in Python, this tool aims to provide the user with a grounded summary by synthesizing data from different platforms.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
items.summary: SkillEvaluator, developed by NVIDIA, offers a multi-layered framework for evaluating the capabilities and plugins of artificial intelligence agents. The tool aims to audit skill quality with functions such as semantic conflict detection, synthetic dataset generation, and measuring agent behaviors.

snapshot.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: open-code-review, developed by Alibaba, offers a hybrid architecture that combines deterministic pipelines and large language models (LLMs) to automate code review processes. Using multilingual rule sets to detect software bugs, the tool provides developers with a secure and efficient review experience by making line-level comments.

snapshot.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.title: google-research/paper-orchestra
items.summary: PaperOrchestra, developed by Google Research, is a multi-agent framework that transforms raw ideas and experiment logs into academic-format LaTeX drafts. The software supports research paper writing by automating literature review and image generation processes.

snapshot.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials (ideas and experimental logs) into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp allows coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, or Copilot) to inspect and control a live Chrome browser. Offered as a Model Context Protocol server and command-line interface (CLI), this tool provides AI assistants with access to Chrome DevTools for automation, debugging, and performance analysis.

snapshot.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents. Chrome DevTools for agents (chrome-devtools-mcp) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI. Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

items.title: sveltejs/svelte
items.summary: Svelte is a web development tool that compiles declarative components into efficient JavaScript code that performs surgical updates to the DOM. Unlike traditional frameworks, it offers a compiler approach that reduces runtime overhead in the browser.

snapshot.description: web development for the rest of us. Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It's a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM.

items.title: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
items.summary: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill is a Python project that provides local video editing tools for coding agents. Working integrated with software development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, this structure makes 42 different FFmpeg tools available via a machine-readable contract and an MCP server without the need for a cloud-based API (a digital bridge that allows two different software programs to communicate with each other).

snapshot.description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.

items.title: Carnegie Mellon is putting computer science courses on YouTube for free
items.summary: Carnegie Mellon University has made course content from the Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science available for free on YouTube. While the platform currently features video lectures, there are plans to add self-paced educational materials in the future.

snapshot.description: Free lectures from Carnegie Mellon's Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science, now on YouTube. Self-paced courseware comes next.

items.title: Technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggers online banking delays for US banks
items.summary: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused delays in online banking transactions at various banks in the United States. The disruption caused interruptions in customers' access to their accounts and transaction processes.

items.title: BugMeNot has closed
items.summary: BugMeNot, a service that listed usernames and passwords shared for logging into websites, has ceased operations. The platform provided a method for users to access sites requiring membership without providing their personal information.

items.title: Windows 11 Is Collecting Data on Which Coding Agents and Developer Tools You Use
items.summary: It has been determined that the Windows 11 operating system collects data on the use of developer tools and coding agents via the MissionControlAggregator component. Reverse engineering studies on diagnostic reports show that the system records telemetry data regarding the use of this software.

snapshot.description: Reverse engineering Windows 11's MissionControlAggregator reveals coding-agent and developer-tool usage bits in a diagnostic ETW report.

items.title: Frame – 31.5" color ePaper display
items.summary: Frame is a 31.5-inch color ePaper display with a wooden frame. Drawing attention with its handmade design, this device uses a color screen technology that offers a wide visual area.

snapshot.description: Hand made wooden body, full color 31.5" display.

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic, shared on Hugging Face, is an AI model that performs text generation. Users can also examine the xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM version, which is based on this model and has been fine-tuned to focus on scientific topics.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Also check out DeepThought, my science finetune based on this model: xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image, offered by MiniMaxAI, is an AI model with text-to-image generation capabilities. The software provides API documentation—digital bridges that allow two different software programs to communicate with each other—for image editing and prompt expansion operations.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. API docs: - Text-to-image: EN-docs, CN-docs - Image editing: EN-docs, CN-docs - Prompt expansion: EN-docs, CN-docs

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, published on Hugging Face, is an AI model that processes image and text inputs to produce text output (image-text-to-text). It has been released as the most capable version of the Qwen open-source model family to date.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Following the widespread community adoption of the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 series, we are pleased to introduce Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: LTX-2.5, developed by Lightricks, is an image-to-video artificial intelligence model. It offers a technology that allows users to transform static images into moving content.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image is an artificial intelligence model capable of text-to-image generation. It is recommended to be used in conjunction with the text generation tool qwen3.59bw4a8gptq during prompt refinement processes.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. For prompt enhancement, we recommend to use the model qwen3.59bw4a8gptq with the Generate Text node.

items.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face focuses on reducing batch processing time in agent workloads working with large language models (LLMs). The study aims to optimize GPU memory management by coordinating inference processes with environment interactions.

snapshot.description: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and pro

items.title: Iris-Z: Scaling One Generative Model Past Specialist Geometry Models
items.summary: Iris-Z is a generative AI model that combines computer vision and spatial understanding tasks under a single architecture. It aims to solve all tasks by scaling a single general model with data and computational power instead of using numerous expert models.

snapshot.description: Language moved from many task-specific models to one unified model: a single generative model with a single generative training task that handles all of them within the same backbone, and keeps improving with data, parameters and compute. We believe the bitter lesson applies just as much to computer vision, 3D and spatial understanding, in the end to visual intelligence: the effort should go into general architectures that solve all these tasks in a unified way, and into scaling them, rather tha

items.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
items.summary: BrickFlow is a method that aims to determine the positions of LEGO pieces and reconstruct objects based on an image. Using a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model to learn how pieces connect to each other, the study optimizes the assembly process of the pieces by taking physical constraints into account.

snapshot.description: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to

items.title: Restoring Diversity in Distilled Image and Video Generators by Probing Activations
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines how distilling diffusion models into few-step student models reduces visual diversity. Researchers have identified the root cause of diversity loss by finding that although student models maintain activation variance, they concentrate this variance into fewer directions.

snapshot.description: Distilling diffusion models into few-step student models substantially reduces sampling latency, but induces severe diversity collapse: samples generated from different random seeds show minimal variation. In this work, we investigate the root cause of this failure by probing the internal representations of student models relative to their teachers. We find that distilled students maintain total activation variance comparable to their teachers, but concentrate it into substantially fewer directi

items.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
items.summary: Re-Search presents an evaluation method based on the twenty questions game to analyze the research idea development processes of large language models (LLMs). The model attempts to reach the core ideas of published papers by asking yes-no questions to solve a given research problem.

snapshot.description: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. glossary.explanation: A structure based on the principle that the system is triggered and operates when a specific condition or action occurs.
A type of software whose source code is open for everyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
A set of tools and libraries that make it easier for developers to build programs for a specific platform or application.
Specialized capability packages added to a system to enable artificial intelligence models to perform specific tasks.
Tools that allow investors to find the opportunities they are looking for by filtering financial data according to specific criteria.
The systematic review process conducted to find errors that could compromise the security or stability of a software.
Security exercises that mimic the methods of malicious attackers to test the resilience of systems.
Short commands initiated by users with a forward slash in a chat or command-line interface.
A virtualization technology that packages software with all the files it needs to run in an isolated environment.
A set of capabilities that allow AI agents to interact with external systems to perform specific tasks.
A capability that enables AI to perform a specific task, such as researching a topic or generating a summary.
Automated processes where data is processed sequentially through different stages to complete a task.
AI models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A software infrastructure that enables multiple AI agents to collaborate with each other to solve complex tasks.
A communication protocol that allows AI models to connect to different data sources and tools in a standardized way.
A text-based interface that runs programs using written commands instead of a mouse.
